questions: What is the range of random frequency? (e.g., 1 to 5 inclusive, 0.1 to 10, etc.)
What is the range of random phase shift? (e.g., 0 to 360 degrees, 0 to 2π radians, etc.)
What is the time range for the x-axis? (e.g., 0 to 10, 0 to 2π, etc.)
Should the phase shift be in degrees or radians? (e.g., degrees as in reference, radians as typical in math.sin)
Should the plot include a grid? (e.g., ax.grid(True) as in reference, or not specified)
What is the number of points to plot? (e.g., 1000 points as in reference, or variable)
Should the function seed randomness for reproducibility? (e.g., using random.seed)
Is the phase shift added inside the sine argument as (xi + phase_shift) or (xi * phase_shift) or other? (e.g., linear addition vs multiplication)
